page.overview:
Who is Gatekeeper?

The , also knows as Friendly Pikku, is a character in the Game Boy Advance version of .

The Gatekeeper appears inside the Palace of the Four Sword blocking the path forward. When talked to, it asks for 20 Rupees in exchange for a hint. After defeating Ganon and completing , the Gatekeeper will allow Link to continue through the Palace after paying the 20 Rupee fee. The Gatekeeper vanishes afterwards.
